deep_audit_observations.finding: Component optima do not imply an optimum of their sum. In the explicit family, direct calculation gives rho+rho^(1/4)c(1-c)^(3/4)-rho*c*(1+c+c^2)/3, with positive right derivative at zero and negative derivative at 1-rho when rho<3/7.
deep_audit_observations.scope_note: If retained, add the direct continuity and endpoint-derivative argument; do not claim a separate Lean theorem.
deep_audit_observations.source_claim: The footnote says Propositions 3.1 and 3.4 imply an interior optimum for traditional social welfare.
